words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes 56:36 open as a consequence of the special creation announced in 56:35, not as a detached new assertion. Its force is both sequence and result: after the prior act, the verse moves into what that act makes them be. Because the particle is proclitic, the connector is fused to {{ar:جَعَلْنَٰهُنَّ}} ({{tr:jaʿalnāhunna}}), so the first sound of the ayah already pulls the making verb backward toward 56:35 and forward toward the result {{ar:أَبْكَارًا}} ({{tr:abkāran}}).

words.prose: {{ar:جَعَلْنَٰهُنَّ}} ({{tr:jaʿalnāhunna}}) is a completed active act: the embedded {{ar:نَا}} ({{tr:nā}}) keeps the divine speaker grammatically inside the verb, and {{ar:هُنَّ}} ({{tr:hunna}}) keeps the definite feminine plural patient attached before the result appears, without renaming the group. Its double-object frame is the main lexical point: the verb does not merely say that they exist, but renders the already carried patient into {{ar:أَبْكَارًا}} ({{tr:abkāran}}). That makes the root's making, setting, and appointing range converge locally as a conferred and set status, while the grammar blocks turning every wider branch of {{ar:ج ع ل}} ({{tr:j-ʿ-l}}) into the local sense. The word also compresses the action relation audibly: {{ar:نَا}} ({{tr:nā}}) precedes {{ar:هُنَّ}} ({{tr:hunna}}), and the nasal chain carries agent into patient before the external predicate arrives. The repeated {{ar:نَٰهُنَّ}} ({{tr:nāhunna}}) shape binds this verb to the prior creation verb in 56:35, so origination hands off to configuration. Same-surah recurrences of the root later configure crop, water, and fire, and the appointment use in 2:30 shows the wider status-setting family without replacing the local result-complement frame.

words.prose: {{ar:أَبْكَارًا}} ({{tr:abkāran}}) is the landing word of the ayah: accusative because it is the result complement of {{ar:جَعَلْنَٰهُنَّ}} ({{tr:jaʿalnāhunna}}), plural because the attached patient is plural, and indefinite because the state is qualitative rather than a named definite class. Its ordinary local sense is virgins or first-state ones, but the root field of {{ar:ب ك ر}} ({{tr:b-k-r}}) keeps that bodily predicate tied to firstness: dawn, early emergence, first fruit, first birth, and unused condition all press the idea of a state before prior event or trace. That first-state pressure becomes concrete as absence of prior wear, predecessor, use, and accumulated history; it sharpens the local predicate without replacing it. The distributional guardrail matters here: this is the marked adjectival qualitative use in a root field otherwise dominated by morning or early-time forms, so the temporal freshness is image-pressure, not a replacement for the local predicate. The shared {{ar:ب ك ر}} ({{tr:b-k-r}}) sound frame lets the movement from dawn and first-fruit freshness into the virgin predicate be heard, and the shorter final word closes with a compact root skeleton and tanwin after the longer act. Placed last, the word gives the clause its result after the act and also answers 56:35 by specifying what the special creation becomes; it then opens the way for the parallel plural attributes in 56:37. The same form in 66:5 shows another context where virgin-state belongs to divine prerogative, while 56:36 makes it the product of this creation-to-configuration sequence.

topics.headline: accusative complement names the result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word is the produced state governed by the making verb, not an independent object or loose circumstance.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the word as the accusative second object or complement of {{ar:جَعَلْنَٰهُنَّ}} ({{tr:jaʿalnāhunna}}); a circumstantial reading remains secondary.

topics.headline: indefinite broken plural distributes the state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the state is spread across the whole plural patient while remaining qualitative rather than a definite named class.
topics.reason: The surface is an indefinite accusative plural adjective; its broken-plural pattern and tanwīn jointly mark plurality, case, and indefiniteness.

topics.headline: virgin state carries firstness pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the local virgin or untouched sense is not just a social label; it is shaped by a broader first-before-event field.
topics.reason: V4 accepts branches for firstness, early emergence, first birth, young unused animals, and virginity; local adjective grammar selects the virgin or untouched state while preserving firstness as pressure.

topics.headline: firstness becomes absence of prior trace
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the concrete image of a condition without prior wear, predecessor, use, or accumulated history.
topics.reason: First-offspring, first-produce, and young-unused-animal branches sharpen the local predicate as image-pressure, but they do not replace the selected human adjectival sense.

topics.headline: morning root is redirected into state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a root field dominated by morning and early-time forms appears here as a rare adjectival state predicate.
topics.reason: Contextual evidence marks this adjectival qualitative occurrence as low-frequency for the root; the distribution makes freshness pressure visible but does not activate morning as the local sense.

topics.headline: sound family carries freshness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shared b-k-r sound frame moving from dawn and first-fruit freshness into the local virgin predicate.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows press a real root-family echo; it is kept as audible and semantic pressure while local grammar keeps the word as an adjective of state.

topics.headline: same form contrasts another assignment scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same form in 66:5, where virgin-state is also tied to divine prerogative, while 56:36 places it under a created-state frame.
topics.reason: The concrete reference to 66:5 supplies a contrast in context, not a replacement for the local syntax.

topics.headline: final word lands the result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the act is heard first and the assigned state arrives as the compact final beat of the ayah.
topics.reason: The word stands after the governing verb as the ayah's closing lexical item, concentrating the result in one predicate.

topics.headline: short result compresses the cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from a morphologically loaded act to a shorter, clipped result word.
topics.reason: The final word is shorter than the preceding verb complex and closes with the b-k-r consonantal frame plus tanwīn.

topics.headline: closure answers 56:35 and opens 56:37
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word both specifies the special creation in 56:35 and becomes the first item in the plural attribute chain continuing in 56:37.
topics.reason: Boundary rows tie the predicate backward to 56:35's unspecified creation and forward to parallel accusative plural descriptors in 56:37.

1. **Transformation into untouched firstness.** `ج ع ل` **B002** supplies turning something into a state and `ب ك ر` **B004** virginity and untouched state. The preceding origination supplies the cause, while the resultative `فـ` supplies sequence. **Abductive move:** I infer that the new state is intentionally produced, not merely discovered. **Reading change:** the ayah stresses effected renewal.

2. **Earliest yield after origination.** `ب ك ر` **B002** supplies the first or earliest yield and **B001** early morning. The later `النشأة الأولى` (56:62) activates firstness as the opening of a cycle. **Abductive move:** I infer a freshness image alongside sexual untouchedness. **Reading change:** `أبكارا` can evoke perpetual first yield and renewed beginning.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Creation in an unknown mode at 56:61 strengthened the reading of `جعل` here as deliberate transformation into renewed firstness.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Origination is specified as an untouched resultant state.** `ج ع ل` (B002, turning something into a state) operates on `ب ك ر` (B004, virginity and untouched state). Ayah 35 supplies fresh bringing-into-being, and ayat 37–40 supply affection, peer equality, assignment, and temporally broad cohorts. The packet supplies creation before state-making; I infer that “untouched” marks renewed integrity rather than social isolation. The line reads as a consequence of re-creation, not an independent valuation detached from the surrounding relational whole.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 56:61 warns that renewed forms exceed present knowledge, correcting over-specification of this state and confirming it as one locally named result of a larger re-creative capacity.

identity_judgment.rationale: Temel kanıt, ortasında ip için oluk bulunan ve su çekmede kullanılan yuvarlak döner parçayı açıkça tanımlar. Kılıç süslemesindeki halkaları da biçim benzerliğine dayalı ikincil kullanım olarak verir; geçici çerçeve bu hiyerarşiyi doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek, ipin üzerinden döndüğü su çekme parçasıdır; kılıç süslemesindeki halkalar yalnız biçim benzerliğine bağlı uzantıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak adın döner su çekme parçası anlamını temel alır ve belirli bir söz öbeğinden bağımsızdır; halka kullanımı biçimsel uzantı olarak kalır.

concept_map.definition: Su çekerken ipin ortasındaki oluk üzerinden döndüğü yuvarlak parça, yani küçük bir makara türüdür; biçim benzerliğiyle kılıç süslemesindeki halkalara da ad olur.

facets.statement: Su çekmede ipin geçtiği oluğa sahip yuvarlak ve döner parçayı belirtir.
Kılıç süslemesindeki halka biçimli parçaları benzerlik yoluyla adlandırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Temel kanıt, gerçek bir döner araçtan söz etmeyen kalıplaşmış anlatımın üç yorumunu açıkça verir: topluluğun eksiksiz biçimde birlikte gelmesi, aynı yoldan veya tarzda gelmesi ve birbiri ardınca gelmesi. Geçici çerçeve bu yorumları alternatifler olarak doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal gerçek bir nesneyi değil, bir topluluğun eksiksiz, aynı biçimde veya art arda gelişini anlatan kalıplaşmış ifadeyi kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam, belirli kalıplaşmış ifadelerde ortaya çıkar; topluluk, aynı yol ve art arda geliş yorumları çıplak bir nesne anlamına dönüştürülmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluğun hiç kimse geride kalmadan hep birlikte gelmesini anlatan kalıplaşmış sözdür; kullanıma göre aynı yoldan veya birbiri ardınca gelme biçiminde de yorumlanır.

Topluluk üyelerinin birbirinin ardından gelmesi biçiminde yorumlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, kalıplaşmış anlatımın gerçek bir nesneye dayanmadığında birleşir; topluca ve eksiksiz geliş, aynı biçimde geliş ve art arda geliş arasında yorum farkı bulunduğunu gösterir.
